jam_guide_0: Every clip has an instrument lane: M = Melody, H = Harmony, B = Bass, D = Beat. The number in [ ] is its width. Drag it into the matching lane with enough consecutive empty cells.
jam_guide_1: Reuse blocks, move between lanes or replace clips. Right-click to remove. There is no countdown.
jam_guide_2: Match the requested Genre and bring your total Melody / Groove / Sound close to the targets. Press Listen to hear your own arrangement without background music. Keep the arrangement before time runs out.
jam_guide_example: Example from this deck: %s [%d] → %s lane. Green cells show the space this clip uses.
jam_busy: Alice and the team are already in a meeting or research session.
jam_staff_busy: Everyone must be free. Finish current recordings before the Lounge meeting.
jam_need_lounge: Build a Lounge to bring the whole team together.
jam_once: This commission already has its completed idea session.
jam_gather_hint: The calendar is held while Producer, Alice and all musicians walk here. The puzzle starts when everyone arrives.
jam_ready_hint: Drag genre blocks onto the grid, or click a block then a cell. Set BPM and listen.
jam_goal: Brief: %s | Target Melody %d / Groove %d / Sound %d. Match the totals without overcrowding the grid.
jam_drag_hint: Drag clips into their instrument lane. Width = occupied steps. Right-click to remove. Or click a clip, then a cell. Gold clips match the genre.
jam_result: Arrangement saved! Brief fit %d/100, Idea +%d. Your MIDI notes will be used in this song.
schedule_future: Choose a future day for a booking; use Start now for today.
schedule_late: This plan finishes after the deadline. Move it earlier or choose a faster team.
schedule_contract: A musician’s contract expires before the scheduled finish. Renew it first.
schedule_conflict: The room or a musician is booked during that time. Choose another day, room or team.
schedule_blocked: “%s” could not start: %s. Please review its Timeline booking.
timeline_drag: Drop on a day to reschedule
tutorial_jobs: Let’s make your first Pop song. Click the highlighted Commissions button. The calendar waits while we set up.
tutorial_talk: Click Talk on the first commission to hear the brief.
tutorial_accept: Read the client’s brief, then choose Accept. Click Continue to read the next line.
tutorial_lounge: Close the job board, open Alice, then choose Idea jam. Everyone will gather in the Lounge.
tutorial_gather: Wait for the team to reach the Lounge, then start composing.
tutorial_arrange: Pick a genre and drag blocks onto the grid. Reuse and mix styles across all four instruments. Listen, then use your song.
tutorial_plan: Open Alice’s Timeline. Plan the song for +1 day, then open Recording.
tutorial_team: Close the desk and open Recording. Tick both starter musicians; the Pop blend is ready for the first song.
tutorial_schedule: Choose a room or Automatic, then click Book recording. This reserves the team and starts on your planned day.
tutorial_wait: Your booking is ready. Close the panels and let x1 run; the recording will start automatically.
tutorial_recording: The band is recording! Use x1, x2 or x4. At 100%, we will review the track and release it.
tutorial_release: Choose the first free marketing plan to release the song. Alice will file the final invoice.
tutorial_done: First song released! You can now manage more jobs, meetings and studio bookings. Click Done to finish the guide.
tutorial_read: Read Alice’s report, then click Continue.
schedule_created: Recording booked. Alice will start the team on the planned day.
